KAZINFORM - Kazakhstan's Muslim Religious Directorate has held a charity event dedicated to the Day of Knowledge of the Almaty Mayor's Office "Almaty Community for Integrated Access to Children". This was reported today by the press service of the company. Within the framework of the program "Promoting tolerance for children with disabilities", 100 children were screened and presented to the school. The Chief Mufti Erjan Gargi Moghajli, who has participated in the celebration, has said that all the people in our country have been able to do the same. "Children in the community are also members of the community. I am grateful to my parents, who are in need of assistance to their children, "said the Chief Mufti Erjan Kazhi Malghajuli.
